headline: Monsoon-related disruptions impact dispatches; expect sharp rebound in H2

highlights: Chhattisgarh sector dispatch was impacted for ~1 month due to a damaged railway line during monsoon.
We build in volume CAGR of 7% over FY26–29E to 60mntpa, baking in moderate steel capacity additions in FY28/29.
Upgrade to BUY (from ADD), with a TP of INR 91, keeping the multiple intact at 6x FY28E EV/EBITDA.
Higher realisations nullified by weak volumes NMDC’s reported EBITDA, at INR 19.4bn (-3% YoY/-21% QoQ), marginally missed our estimate.
valuation: Upgrade to BUY (from ADD), with a TP of INR 91, keeping the multiple intact at 6x FY28E EV/EBITDA.
